The '''Simik system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The half-[[Morellian]]-half-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Roland Warren]] served as an undercover contact in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Simik system was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed it in grid square L-14.<ref name="TEA" />
